import json,re
d=json.load(open('../workdir/tool-observer/index.json'))
for i,e in enumerate(d['events']):
  if e.get('tool_name')!='Read' or 'system-spec-harness/skills' not in (e.get('input_summary') or ''): continue
  j=json.load(open('../workdir/tool-observer/'+e['file'])); ti=j['tool_input']; p=ti['file_path']
  if not (p.endswith('SKILL.md') or '/prompts/' in p or 'chapter-template' in p): continue
  r=j.get('tool_result_content'); r=r if isinstance(r,str) else json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)
  nums=[int(m) for m in re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*(\d+)\t',r)]
  n=sum(1 for _ in open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
  print(e['stream'][-8:],i,p.split('skills/')[1],'off/lim',ti.get('offset'),ti.get('limit'),'read',(min(nums) if nums else None),'-',(max(nums) if nums else None),'file_lines',n, 'ERR' if j.get('is_error') else '')
"
